name: Asmongold
role: American streamer and political commentator (Zack Hoyt, born 1990)
summary: Zack Hoyt, known as Asmongold, is a former World of Warcraft streamer who became one of the most-watched political commentators on Twitch and YouTube. He combines hardline positions on immigration, national sovereignty, crime and executive power with support for universal basic income, single-payer health care, higher taxes on the rich and legal abortion. An atheist, he says he wants America to remain a culturally Christian country.

universal-healthcare.rationale: In Dec 2024 he said the real solution to the insurance problem is single-payer health care, 'what should have happened years ago'; in 2024 he said poor people must have access to medical care.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Calls himself 'a massive free market advocate' while insisting markets need oversight (2024); chose 'markets with rules and a safety net' in 2026.

public-ownership.rationale: Answered 'it depends' on keeping strategic companies under public control (2026), arguing a monopoly local electricity company needs public control.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: He proposes two new tax brackets for incomes above $5M and $10M (2025), 'massively increase taxes on rich people' to fund UBI, and calls billionaires the people who 'need to be taxed' (2026).

property-fundamental.rationale: In 2026 he argued 'ownership is a construct' defined by the state, so the state taking property is not theft; 'ownership is fake'.

regulate-corporations.rationale: On the Political Compass (2024) he said a genuine free market requires restrictions, strongly agreed government should penalise businesses that mislead the public, and said corporations can be trusted to harm the environment for money.

cut-welfare.rationale: Wants the food-stamp income threshold raised so more people qualify (Jan 2026) and says he is 'a very big fan of welfare states' (2025); he does favour work expectations for the able.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Strongly rejected 'only wrongdoers need worry about surveillance' (2024); in 2026 said state monitoring of digital conversations 'depends on a warrant'.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Says marijuana possession should not be an offence at all (2024) and calls addicts victims rather than criminals (2024), but wants dealers prosecuted; mixed on drugs generally.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Opposed the UK conviction of a man for burning a Quran under public-order/hate law, calling it 'authoritarian' and saying all religions must be open to mockery (2025).

strong-leader.rationale: Strongly agreed a strong leader should be able to govern without the legislature in a crisis (Oct 2026); praises acting 'overnight' without asking Congress (Sep 2026) and said he dislikes that Trump 'is not more authoritarian' (2025).

state-harmful.rationale: Says a country cannot exist without taxes and a state that defines ownership (2026); backs welfare and policing.

limit-guns.rationale: Strongly agreed adults should be allowed to keep firearms (2026) and argues gun ownership is justified even without the Second Amendment; would only bar the documented mentally ill.

empower-police-military.rationale: Lists doubling police funding among his own policy priorities (2025); calls himself 'a very big police supporter' (2024).

decide-locally.rationale: Strongly disagreed regions and localities should run their own affairs without the national government ('we fought a war over it') and disagreed states should write their own constitutions (2026).

rehabilitation.rationale: In 2024 he rejected putting punishment over rehabilitation, but by 2025-26 he calls for mandatory prison even for petty shoplifting and says some criminals cannot be rehabilitated; mixed, recent leaning punitive.

traditional-family.rationale: Completely agreed the family is the most important unit in society (May 2026) and picked 'faith, family and national tradition' as what society should rest on (Oct 2026).

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Strongly disagreed that 'real marriage is between a man and a woman'; same-sex couples must be treated the same by the state (Oct 2026).

abortion-legal.rationale: Completely agreed abortion should be legal in all circumstances (May 2026); 'I'm very much an abortion supporter' (2024).

more-religion-public.rationale: Agreed religion should be encouraged, strongly rejected removing God from the constitution and political speeches, and wants Christianity to influence American policy (Oct 2026), though he is not a believer.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Disagreed that racial inequality disadvantaging groups should be addressed, saying the disadvantage today runs against white people (May 2026).

gender-social-construct.rationale: Disagreed that gender is a social construct and says 'there's only two genders' (2026).

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Completely agreed the state may enforce unity of culture and language (May 2026); immigrants who reject local customs should lose the right to stay (Oct 2026).

reduce-immigration.rationale: 'I don't think that we should accept immigrants' and would take zero asylum seekers (Nov 2025); would deport legal residents who are not net taxpayers (2025).

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Totally agreed all sovereignty should stay national rather than pass to the EU or UN (May 2026) and rejected UN mediation before military action (Oct 2026).

free-trade.rationale: Disagreed, not strongly, that the world would be better as a single global market (2026); free-trade agreements 'depend'.

nation-first.rationale: Says only citizens' interests matter in policy and that other countries' opinions are 'the least important question in the world' (Nov 2025).

open-borders.rationale: Completely disagreed that borders and nation-states should be abolished (May 2026).

limit-growth.rationale: Agreed in a 2024 quiz that growth hinders curbing warming, but in 2026 attacked Europe for crippling its economy over climate; mixed.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Believes humans affect the climate (2023-2025), but says Europe 'handicapped your entire economy' for environmental goals and that the renewables push weakens the West (2026); recent leaning against.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Reacting to a pro-nuclear video he said 'I love this topic' and agreed the push for renewables over nuclear handicaps the West (Sep 2026).

experts-over-public.rationale: Answered 'depends' on unelected experts governing but chose 'elites decide with limited voting' (2026).

tax-inheritance.rationale: On protecting family inheritance from redistribution (2026) he said he supports some tax but 'not a huge level', and settled on neutral.

basic-income.rationale: Repeatedly backs UBI: 'I am a universal basic income person' (Oct 2025), 'UBI, you know it, I know it' (Nov 2025), 'I'm in favor of universal basic income' (Nov 2025).

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Strongly agreed cheap Chinese electric cars should pay tariffs to protect local factories (2026) and that protectionism is sometimes necessary (2024), but answered 'depends' on limiting imports generally.

one-party-rule.rationale: Agreed a one-party state avoids delay but said 'the disadvantage is way worse' (2024).

democracy-best.rationale: Chose 'elites decide with limited voting' over checked democracy, said 'I do believe in democracy, just not for everybody' and preferred authoritarian rule if it sped development (Oct 2026); 'not a huge supporter of democracy' (2025).

natural-rulers.rationale: Agreed a strong hierarchy in society is desirable (May 2026) and says many voters are 'stupid'.

political-violence-never.rationale: Condemned the killing of the UnitedHealthcare CEO: if people kill whoever they have a problem with 'everybody is going to be killing each other' (2024); his calls for violence concern state force.

separate-church-state.rationale: Disagreed that religion should not influence public policy: 'I want Christianity influencing American policy' (Oct 2026).

military-superiority.rationale: 'In a perfect world only America would have nukes so we could have a complete asymmetrical advantage over everybody else' (Mar 2026); picked 'an influential military power' (Oct 2026) and wants the military 'feared by the world' (2025).

colonial-reparations.rationale: Rejected reparations ('No, I don't'), said the colonised benefited and his country need not apologise (May 2026).

accelerate-technology.rationale: Chose 'accelerate technology, no brakes... speedrunning the singularity' as technology's role (Oct 2026).

results-over-ideology.rationale: 'All behaviors are judged on their outcome. And if it's a good outcome, then it's a good behavior' (Sep 2026).

direct-action.rationale: Says you can vote your way out 'to an extent' but must also take over local authority structures and act without permission (Sep 2026).

means-match-ends.rationale: 'Lie, cheat, do whatever you need to do in order to obtain power and then... use it in a vindictive way'; 'nothing is off the table when you're trying to win' (Sep 2026).

distribute-by-need.rationale: Agreed (not strongly) with 'from each according to ability, to each according to need' on the Political Compass (2024), reading it as support for progressive taxation.

taxation-theft.rationale: Strongly disagreed that taxation is theft (2026): 'you have to have taxes... you can't have a country' without them.

harm-principle.rationale: Said his approach is that you can do what you want unless you hurt others, with a very high bar for intervening in self-harm; also said some behaviour that makes someone a drag on society might merit attention.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Rejected racial IQ claims in 2024; in a May 2026 third-party clip agreed with a post dismissing socioeconomic explanations; mixed.

national-rebirth.rationale: Agreed with a video that the West is in its 'death throes' demanding definitive action within years (Sep 2026) and says progressives let society decay (Oct 2026).

territorial-expansion.rationale: Disagreed that invading and claiming another country's land is immoral (May 2026), partly in jest about colonialism; supports US control over Greenland for security.

universal-morality.rationale: Describes himself as a moral nihilist who sees morality and principles as 'top-down ideas given to you by the elites' (per Wikipedia citing The Atlantic); in 2026 said 'all behaviors are judged on their outcome'.

force-without-un.rationale: Rejected the UN mediating conflicts before military action (2026) and says the US is not accountable to international bodies (2026); in 2024 he had mildly disagreed that military action defying international law is sometimes justified.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Says a welfare state, UBI and free childcare are good 'but it has to be for' citizens; unskilled immigrants who do not contribute should not draw on it (Nov 2025).

work-for-welfare.rationale: Agreed, not strongly, that those able to work who refuse should not expect society's support (2024 quiz).

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Rejected 'a mother's first duty is to be a homemaker' as for couples to decide (2024), but wants only men drafted and says men and women 'aren't equal' (2024).

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Disagreed that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind, in both quiz videos.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Strongly disagreed immigrants need not abandon their customs: 'You either assimilate or get the [expletive] out' (Oct 2026).

elite-replacement.rationale: Says opponents 'want white to become a minority' via birthright citizenship and open borders (Apr 2026) and that foreign influences want to 'ethnically replace you... This isn't a conspiracy' (Apr 2026).

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Completely disagreed that society is fundamentally sexist and patriarchal (May 2026).

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Strongly disagreed people with serious inheritable disabilities should be barred from reproducing: 'who decides on that' (2024).

night-watchman-state.rationale: Backs a welfare state, UBI, single-payer health care and free childcare, far beyond defence, justice and property (2024-2025).

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Completely agreed people should be treated equally regardless of race, gender or creed (May 2026), though he elsewhere ranks cultures as superior and inferior.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Holds that one law binds everyone whatever their religion and that religious practice yields where it conflicts with law (Nov 2025).

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Strongly opposed his child's school instilling religion (2024); he has since said he wants Christianity to shape policy, so the schools view may have softened.

consent-of-governed.rationale: 'People have the right to be governed by who they choose', even racists or communists (2025), arguing against banning the AfD.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: On the AfD (2025) he first said a ban was fine if proven, then argued people have the right to elect whoever they choose and banning a popular party takes away their vote.

separated-powers.rationale: Urges the president to 'Andrew Jackson' the Supreme Court, praises acting without telling Congress and wants judges jailed or removed (2026).

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Says he does not want to import Somali tribal conflicts or Middle Eastern blood feuds into America and that newcomers' values change a country (2025-26).

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Strongly agreed the government may impose curfews in a serious situation and a leader may bypass the legislature in a crisis (2026); wants protesters he calls domestic terrorists sent to Guantanamo or labour camps.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Totally agreed sovereignty should be kept at national level rather than granting powers to bodies like the EU (May 2026).

unlimited-reelection.rationale: In 2025 said Trump 'shouldn't run for a third term' and the two-term intent is clear, but also said repeated re-election is not dictatorship and in 2026 floated voting for a third term.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Completely disagreed that there are only different cultures and no savage or civilised ones: 'there are inferior cultures' (2024); called Palestinian culture inferior (Oct 2024).

death-penalty.rationale: Agreed the death penalty should exist 'for a lot of crimes' (May 2026), reversing his 2024 cost-based opposition.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Answered neutral/'it depends' on teaching teenagers about sexuality and gender without taboos (2026).

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Said he wants no religion in school at all, which implies opposition to teaching creationism; he was not asked about creationism.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Agreed pornography of consenting adults should be legal for adults (2024), while saying openness about sex has gone too far.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: 'If both parents are not citizens, you should not be able to have a kid and have it be a citizen' (Nov 2025); calls birthright citizenship an 'exploit' (2026).

minority-language-support.rationale: Strongly disagreed that coexistence of different languages in a country should be encouraged (Oct 2026).

religious-exemptions.rationale: 'Shouldn't make exceptions for religion... the law overrules religion every time' (Nov 2025).

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Would cut foreign aid by about 80% with a goal of 100% (2025).

flat-income-tax.rationale: Said he agrees with scaling (progressive) taxes and disagreed that the rich are too highly taxed.

women-must-cover.rationale: Supports Denmark-style bans on full-face veils in public (Nov 2025), the opposite of compelling covering.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Called it a power imbalance that judges can 'overrule the entire popular vote' (2025) and said Trump should ignore the Supreme Court if it rules against him on birthright citizenship (2026).

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Strongly agreed many colonised peoples benefited from colonialism and joked about 'bringing back colonialism' (May 2026).

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Agreed programmes for diversity, equity and inclusion should end ('that's my big one'), says preferential hiring disadvantages whites (May 2026), and rejected race-based quotas (Oct 2026).

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Agreed with a guest that hiring and firing for racial reasons is a real problem that legislation may address (Nov 2025), objecting mainly to double standards.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Disagreed that land should not be bought and sold: 'of course you should be able to own land' (2024).

single-official-language.rationale: 'I don't want people speaking other languages besides English in America' (May 2026); strongly disagreed that several languages should be used in everyday life (Oct 2026).

corporate-influence.rationale: Says it is 'very bad' that billionaires like Musk can threaten legislators with primary spending (2024) and calls this oligarchy long-standing.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Calls for removing 'foreign forces and foreign agents' including by stopping foreign funding (Apr 2026); the remark is cut off in the captions.

non-intervention.rationale: Strongly disagreed that no country has the right to change another's government: 'any time that we can, then we have the right to do it' (2026); cheered the seizure of Venezuela's leader (2026).

national-law-over-international.rationale: Says 'unelected globalist bureaucrats have no business' over American sovereignty: 'We don't have to do what they say' (Jul 2026).

religious-nation.rationale: 'This is a Christian country and it should be for Christian people' (Oct 2026), while describing himself as an atheist who is culturally Christian.

socialized-care.rationale: Lists free childcare among welfare-state benefits he favours for citizens (Nov 2025); housework is not addressed.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Agreed what consenting adults do in private is no business of the state (2024) and said 'you want to be a gay boy, be a gay boy' (2026).

suppress-opposition.rationale: Hopes the DOJ will 'make up whatever they possibly can' to jail Gavin Newsom (2026), wants opposing city leaders tried and jailed, and suggests denaturalising and deporting congresspeople (Sep 2026).

punish-blasphemy.rationale: 'You should be able to make fun of... Judaism, Islam and Christianity... criticize all of them' and called UK blasphemy-style prosecution authoritarian (2025).

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Said transgender people are not the gender they say (May 2026), but would use his own child's pronouns and does not object to trans soldiers who can do the job (2025).

assisted-dying.rationale: Strongly agreed voluntary euthanasia should be legal for the terminally ill (2026 quiz).

islam-incompatible.rationale: Called Palestinian culture, with Sharia law, 'antithetical to everything Western values stand for' (Oct 2024) and backs curbs on Islamic practices in Denmark (2025), but in 2026 said moderate Muslims and Christians can coexist.

social-market-economy.rationale: Picked 'markets with rules and a safety net' as how production should be organised, calling it 'the obvious one' (Oct 2026 quiz).

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Warns AI will let a small elite consolidate wealth into a 'neofeudalism' rivalling Rome (2025) and says billionaires like Musk having so much political power is 'very bad' (2024).

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Wants police funding doubled and more people jailed (2025), the opposite of abolition.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Rejected the Political Compass item that charity is better than social security (2024).

rent-control.rationale: Agreed the government should be able to freeze rents in a serious crisis (2026 quiz).

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Said violence is acceptable in self-defence, and strongly agreed with 'an eye for an eye', including military force.

online-anonymity.rationale: Calls internet ID 'inevitably and unfortunately coming' and says he would resist it in some ways (2026), though in 2025 he accepted ID checks run through an encrypted government system.

gm-crops.rationale: Strongly agreed genetically modified crops should continue to be developed (2026 quiz).

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Strongly disagreed that no cause justifies starting a war (2026) and backed starting the Iran war (2025-26).

public-service-media.rationale: Agreed (he put it at '85 to 95%') that no broadcasting institution should receive public funding, because 'if you're involved with government money you're accountable to the government' (2024).

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Wants America, and ideally only America, to hold nuclear weapons for an asymmetric advantage (Mar 2026), the opposite of unilateral disarmament.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Wants 'instant mandatory prison time' for any shoplifting (2025), favouring fixed punishment over discretion.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: 'If you can't speak English, get out of the country' (Oct 2026).

premarital-sex.rationale: Strongly disagreed that sex outside marriage is usually immoral (2024).

race-social-construct.rationale: Agreed races are a scientific, biological reality (May 2026 quiz).

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Cheered US defiance of the International Criminal Court: 'I've been waiting on this for 20 years... We're not accountable to them' (Jul 2026).

equal-conscription.rationale: Says women should 'absolutely not' be subject to the draft, while men register (2024).

automate-paid-work.rationale: 'If there's a job that can be replaced by a robot, I think that you should do that' (Oct 2025); welcomed replacing service jobs with kiosks because such work is not a good use of a person's time (2024).

material-over-identity.rationale: Says identity politics was turned up after Occupy Wall Street as a top-down distraction from oligarchy (2025) and that economic class matters more than identity (2026).

notes:
Most positions come from his own spoken words in stream captions, including two on-stream quizzes (Political Compass, Feb 2024; a 12-axis quiz, Oct 2026) and a values quiz (May 2026). Where his views moved, the most recent clear statement is used: he opposed the death penalty in 2024 but backed it in 2026; he favoured rehabilitation in 2024 but now calls for mandatory prison; his 2024 rejection of racial IQ claims conflicts with a 2026 clip. He often speaks provocatively, and only answers given plainly (quiz answers, stated policy wishes) were used; jokes were set aside. Media Matters items were used only for dated verbatim quotes from his videos. Endorsements (Fishback, Rubio for 2028) were not counted as positions.

Merged with an independent claude-sonnet-5-5 audit: 5 answers taken from it, 28 agreed, 7 conflicts settled by the integrator: the 2025-26 positions win as most recent; limit-growth set mixed; the earlier restrict-pornography +1 contradicted its own rationale.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Where his views changed or differed between the 2020 and 2024 quiz runs, or the 2025-26 quotes are later, the most recent position is used and the rationale notes the earlier answer. Later quotes come via Media Matters, a critical outlet, so only verbatim dated quotes were used. Quiz answers were read from auto-captions and are sometimes jokes or hedged; unclear ones (for example one-party rule, where 2024 gave no clear answer) were left null. 2025-26 quotes favor hardline immigration enforcement and a more authoritarian Trump, which sits uneasily with some quiz answers.
